items.title: 67255_Helen Humes oral history interview
items.q: Previn called and told me to ask you, could he be on your next session and I said, 'are you kidding?' I'd love to have him on all the sessions.

ctx.x: No. If he felt lost he didn't play like he felt lost.
So he enjoyed it. Well, didn't you tell me that Koenig called you afterwards about that session?
Yeah, he wanted to ask me something, and he said, Previn called and told me to ask you, could he be on your next session and I said, 'are you kidding?' I'd love to have him on all the sessions.
